module_summary: Valid/ready stream delay stage: an Idle/Valid/Ready FSM loads a down-counter with a fixed or LFSR-random delay and releases the handshake when it expires.

anchors.name: gen_delay.state_q
anchors.why: Idle/Valid/Ready state gating valid_o, ready_o, counter load and enable

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Input valid starting a delayed transfer from Idle

anchors.name: ready_o
anchors.why: Upstream ready, forwarded from ready_i only in Ready state

anchors.name: valid_o
anchors.why: Output valid asserted in Ready state after delay

anchors.name: ready_i
anchors.why: Downstream ready completing transfer and returning FSM to Idle

anchors.name: payload_o
anchors.why: Output payload, direct copy of payload_i

anchors.name: gen_delay.count_out
anchors.why: Delay counter value; zero moves FSM from Valid to Ready

anchors.name: gen_delay.counter_load
anchors.why: Delay value loaded into counter, fixed or from LFSR

anchors.name: gen_delay.load
anchors.why: Loads counter and advances LFSR when transfer accepted in Idle

anchors.name: gen_delay.en
anchors.why: Counter decrement enable asserted in Valid state

groups.name: Delay FSM
groups.description: Sequences Idle, Valid wait and Ready handshake release

groups.name: Delay counter
groups.description: Down-counter loaded with fixed or random delay

groups.name: Stream handshake
groups.description: Input and output valid/ready stream with pass-through payload
